title: Gated experiment lifecycle checklist and risk buckets
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Define a lightweight, operational gating lifecycle for feature experiments (A/B, canary, multi-arm) that standardizes milestones, risk buckets, metric burn-in windows, and automatic rollback signals. Deliver a checklist that PMs/Eng/Design can follow for rollout planning and a template for Console rollout gates.
acceptance_criteria: Checklist covers pre-launch guardrails, staged traffic quotas, continuous monitoring windows, and rollback taxonomy
Integrates with Console rollouts dashboard (routing, traffic %, model variant mapping) and alerts
Playbook includes three risk buckets with concrete SLOs, metric thresholds, and required artifact templates
Templates validated in at least two upcoming experiments (routing and model-upgrade)

notes: 2026-02-20: Decision to adopt three-tier risk buckets (Low/Medium/High) tied to customer_impact and tail latency exposure; trade-off: adds more rollout friction vs. safer defaults - note by Liam Chen

2026-03-02: Observability hooks will include prefix KV cache hit rate, 99th token latency, and quality regression score (AUC over eval set). Need SRE capacity to add two tracing spans - note by SRE lead Maya Kapoor
